entries.title: Philemon 1:1
segments: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon our beloved and fellow-worker,

entries.title: Philemon 1:2
segments: and to Apphia our sister, and to Archippus our fellow-soldier, and to the church in thy house:

entries.title: Philemon 1:3
segments: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:4
segments: I thank my God always, making mention of thee in my prayers,

entries.title: Philemon 1:5
segments: hearing of thy love, and of the faith which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints;

entries.title: Philemon 1:6
segments: that the fellowship of thy faith may become effectual, in the knowledge of every good thing which is in you, unto Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:7
segments: For I had much joy and comfort in thy love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through thee, brother.

entries.title: Philemon 1:8
segments: Wherefore, though I have all boldness in Christ to enjoin thee that which is befitting,

entries.title: Philemon 1:9
segments: yet for love's sake I rather beseech, being such a one as Paul the aged, and now a prisoner also of Christ Jesus:

entries.title: Philemon 1:10
segments: I beseech thee for my child, whom I have begotten in my bonds, Onesimus,

entries.title: Philemon 1:11
segments: who once was unprofitable to thee, but now is profitable to thee and to me:

entries.title: Philemon 1:12
segments: whom I have sent back to thee in his own person, that is, my very heart:

entries.title: Philemon 1:13
segments: whom I would fain have kept with me, that in thy behalf he might minister unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

entries.title: Philemon 1:14
segments: but without thy mind I would do nothing; that thy goodness should not be as of necessity, but of free will.

entries.title: Philemon 1:15
segments: For perhaps he was therefore parted [from thee] for a season, that thou shouldest have him for ever;

entries.title: Philemon 1:16
segments: no longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much rather to thee, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

entries.title: Philemon 1:17
segments: If then thou countest me a partner, receive him as myself.

entries.title: Philemon 1:18
segments: But if he hath wronged the at all, or oweth [thee] aught, put that to mine account;

entries.title: Philemon 1:19
segments: I Paul write it with mine own hand, I will repay it: that I say not unto thee that thou owest to me even thine own self besides.

entries.title: Philemon 1:20
segments: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my heart in Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:21
segments: Having confidence in thine obedience I write unto thee, knowing that thou wilt do even beyond what I say.

entries.title: Philemon 1:22
segments: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I hope that through your prayers I shall be granted unto you.

entries.title: Philemon 1:23
segments: Epaphras, my fellow-prisoner in Christ Jesus, saluteth thee;

entries.title: Philemon 1:24
segments: [and so do] Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke, my fellow-workers.

entries.title: Philemon 1:25
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
